visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of a white cream-covered round cake adorned with fresh sliced strawberries, oranges, and blueberries, featuring a pink "Happy Birthday" placard. A spoon cuts into the side to reveal a vibrant red berry jam core amidst white icy layers on a light wood tabletop. (2) A person's hand using a metal offset spatula carefully spreads thick, smooth white cream onto the exterior of a round cake in a clean, bright indoor kitchen setting. (3) A mound of fluffy white shaved ice is shown topped with a dollop of white cream and a small, round bear-shaped cookie. Purple floral garnishes sit at the base of the ice mound. (4) A large stainless steel bowl is filled with a colorful medley of diced kiwi, mango, strawberries, and grapes soaking in a clear, shimmering syrup; a metal ladle scoops a portion of the fruit. (5) Liquid white condensed milk is poured from a small white ceramic pitcher over the bear-cookie-topped shaved ice, coating the cream. A spoon then lifts a large, creamy section of the dessert. (6) A tall, layered dessert glass is presented, showcasing distinct sections of green matcha sponge, white cream, and red berries, topped with a pink ice cream scoop, a macaron, and a miniature white dog figurine. (7) A brown ribbed mug is filled with bright green matcha latte, decorated with a tiny piece of gold leaf. Nearby, a hand breaks open a golden-brown bear-shaped Madeleine cake to show its soft, porous interior. (8) Interior view of a dessert shop featuring light wood tables, long built-in benches with round gray cushions, and a blue and white wave-patterned wall mural under bright, even lighting. (9) An outdoor round sign with a green fan/shell logo and "Lady B" text is displayed against a clear blue sky, marking the store's entrance.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional showcase for a dessert cafe named Lady B (貝殼夫人) in Kaohsiung. It uses visually appealing close-ups of creative desserts like 'cake-shaped shaved ice' and matcha parfaits combined with high-energy narration and upbeat music to entice viewers to visit the shop.
